function.name: list_tiktok_integration_instances
function.description: The tenant's connected TikTok Shop integration instances. Resolve the instance to work on here — its `id` is the `tikTokShopIntegrationInstance` path segment every other operation takes. Confirm the name/shop with the user when more than one is connected. (GET /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances)

function.name: get_listing_quality_summary
function.description: Tier counts for the instance — total_products, diagnosed, undiagnosed, and poor / fair / good — the starting picture that sizes the run and sets the POOR-first order. (GET /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/listing-quality/summary)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id (from list-tiktok-integration-instances).

function.name: list_listing_quality
function.description: Paginated TikTok products with their latest stored diagnosis, worst-first by default. Each row carries id (the TikTok-product row id the diagnose-one path takes), tiktok_product_id, title, main_image_url, current_tier, remaining_recommendations, total_issues, field_summary, the full diagnoses[] (field, diagnosis_results[].{code,how_to_solve,quality_tier}, seo_words), diagnosed_at, is_diagnosed and mapped_product. This is the work queue. (GET /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/listing-quality)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id.

filter[tier].description: Tier(s), comma-separated: POOR, FAIR, GOOD. e.g. "POOR" or "POOR,FAIR".

filter[undiagnosed].description: true = only never-diagnosed listings; false = only diagnosed ones. Omit for all.

filter[search].description: Free-text over the TikTok title and tiktok_product_id.

sort.description: Sort field, prefix - for descending. tier (worst-first, the default), remaining_recommendations, diagnosed_at, title, id.

function.name: diagnose_listings
function.description: (Re)diagnose many listings via a background tracked job — an initial or refresh sweep. Pass `ids` (selected TikTok-product row ids) OR `diagnose_all: true`. Returns data.tracked_job_log_id; progress shows in the job tray. Prefer diagnose-one-listing for the tight fix→verify loop, where you need the refreshed diagnosis back synchronously. (POST /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/listing-quality/diagnose)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id.

ids.description: TikTok-product row ids to diagnose (the `id` field of listing-quality rows). Required unless diagnose_all is true.

diagnose_all.description: Diagnose every non-archived listing on the instance instead of a selected set.

fields.description: Which optimization suggestions TikTok should return, any of TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE, ALL, NONE. Pass ["ALL"] to get seo_words for every field; defaults to ["NONE"] (issue list only, no suggestions).

function.name: diagnose_one_listing
function.description: (Re)diagnose a single listing synchronously and return its refreshed diagnosis resource (current_tier, remaining_recommendations, diagnoses[]). This is the verification call: run it before fixing a stale/missing diagnosis, and again after the fix is applied to confirm the tier moved. 403 if the product isn't on this instance; 422 if it has no TikTok category to diagnose against. (POST /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/products/{tikTokShopProduct}/diagnose)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id.

tikTokShopProduct.description: The SKU.io TikTok-product row id (the `id` field of a listing-quality row), NOT the tiktok_product_id.

function.name: draft_listing_optimization
function.description: AI-draft improved copy for whichever of TITLE/DESCRIPTION the listing was flagged on, grounded in the current copy, TikTok's `how_to_solve` guidance and the suggested `seo_words`. Returns ai_available plus title/description blocks ({current, proposed, issue}) and seo_words. proposed is null when AI is unavailable/disabled (AiSettings.ai_listing_quality_enabled) or the field has no issue — the drawer then prefills the current text for manual editing. The draft is a proposal: the merchant approves before it is sent to apply-listing-optimization. (POST /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/products/{tikTokShopProduct}/optimize/draft)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id.

tikTokShopProduct.description: The SKU.io TikTok-product row id (the `id` field of a listing-quality row).

function.name: apply_listing_optimization
function.description: Apply the merchant-approved fixes to the live TikTok listing via TikTok's Partial Edit Product seam, then re-diagnose. Send any subset of title / description / main_image_url (at least one required). The main_image_url is a public URL to a real sourced photo that the backend fetches, uploads to TikTok as MAIN_IMAGE, and sets while preserving the rest of the gallery — images are never AI-generated. Returns applied[] (which fields changed) and audit.status. 403 if the product isn't on this instance; 422 on validation; the call surfaces a clear error if TikTok rejects the edit or the image can't be used. (POST /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{tikTokShopIntegrationInstance}/products/{tikTokShopProduct}/optimize)

tikTokShopIntegrationInstance.description: The SKU.io TikTok Shop integration instance id.

tikTokShopProduct.description: The SKU.io TikTok-product row id (the `id` field of a listing-quality row).

title.description: Approved new product title, plain text, max 255. Required if description and main_image_url are both omitted.
title.example: Walbro 400-766 255 LPH High Pressure In-Tank Fuel Pump Kit

description.description: Approved new product description as TikTok HTML. Required if title and main_image_url are both omitted.

main_image_url.description: Public URL to a sourced replacement main image (≥600×600). The backend fetches and uploads it to TikTok. Required if title and description are both omitted.
